You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT id, name, id AS root_id, 0 AS depth, 1.0::DOUBLE AS qty_mult
    FROM packaging
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pr.contains_id, p.name, p.root_id, p.depth + 1, (p.qty_mult::DOUBLE) * (pr.qty::DOUBLE)
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    JOIN packaging_tree p ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id, name, root_id, depth, qty_mult
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
all_leaf_totals AS (
    SELECT root_id, id AS leaf_id, qty_mult AS total_qty
    FROM leaf_items
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_leaf_items,
    SUM(total_qty) AS total_all_leaves,
    AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_qty
FROM all_leaf_totals

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT p.id as root_id, p.id as curr_id, p.name as curr_name, 0 as depth, 1 as multiplier
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pt.root_id, p.id, p.name, pt.depth + 1, pt.multiplier * CAST(prr.qty AS BIGINT)
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations prr ON pt.curr_id = prr.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p ON p.id = prr.contains_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT pt.root_id, SUM(pt.multiplier) as total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt

)

        contains_id AS current_id,

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        packaging_id,
        contains_id,
        qty as current_qty,
        0 as level,
        packaging_id as root_id
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        ph.current_qty * pr.qty as current_qty,
        ph.level + 1,
        ph.root_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    JOIN packaging_hierarchy ph ON pr.packaging_id = ph.contains_id
),
true_leaves AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(current_qty) as total_leaf_quantity
    FROM packaging_hierarchy
    WHERE contains_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_leaf_quantity) as avg_total_quantity,
    COUNT(*) as num_combinations
FROM true_leaves
